title: Fabrication of flexible Cu-TiO2 nanosheet photocatalysts on carbon cloth for solar hydrogen production via a self-healing Cu redox loop
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00012F, Paper
Mariyum Yousaf, Phommachanh Anny, Hui Hu, Muhammad Sohail, Yun Gao
A flexible, self-healing Cu-TiO2 photocatalyst on carbon cloth achieves solar to hydrogen (STH) through a dynamic Cu0 ⇌ Cu+ ⇌ Cu2+ redox loop, lattice oxygen regulation, and efficient charge transfer—offering a scalable pathway for durable STH.
